lead.text: Moss has raised a huge €35m Series C at a €1bn valuation. Germany's newest unicorn. Founded in 2019 by Ante Spittler with three co-founders, Moss now works with mid-market finance teams across Europe, sitting between those teams and every euro that leaves the business, with the receipt, the approval and the ERP line attached to each one. Round led by Portage with Cherry Ventures following on. That is the ninth German company past a billion inside twelve months. Congratulations to the team. Made in Germany. Built by startups.

source.title: Moss hits a €1 billion valuation and bets on Finance AI shaped by finance teams

lead.foundersLabel: Ante Spittler, Anton Rummel, Ferdinand Meyer and Stephan Haslebacher

lead.text: NavVis has raised a huge €73.7m Series D. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich thirteen years ago by four researchers, NavVis maps the inside of factories, plants and the mission-critical infrastructure nobody photographs, and keeps the digital copy synchronised with the physical one. Round led by the American private equity firm The Jordan Company, with Yttrium, KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING and Cipio Partners following on. Felix Reinshagen says customers trust it with billions of square metres of that data. Thirteen years of unfashionable engineering, a growth round from abroad, and the headquarters still in Munich. Congratulations to the team. Made in Germany. Built by startups.

source.title: Munich-based NavVis raises €73.7 million to build its spatial data engine and accelerate AI roadmap

lead.text: metr has raised €10.5m in a Series B. It sells energy and heating management into German housing stock, the least fashionable corner of climate software and the one with the most carbon sitting in it. Six of the roughly fifty European rounds Tech.eu tracked that week were German, and none was larger than €12m. Late July is when the country goes on holiday and the funding calendar goes with it, so that is a verdict on the month rather than on the pipeline. Congratulations to the team.

source.title: European tech weekly recap: €878M in weekly deals and key trends from H1 2026

lead.text: 5U AI has raised $3.2m in pre-seed funding. Founded a year ago by two Technical University of Munich graduates, Yagiz Abik and Fehmi Şener, it builds digital workers for freight forwarding that quote, book, track shipments and reconcile invoices, and that record the reasoning behind every decision so a freight team can audit it. Round led by London's Emerge Capital. One year from the lecture hall to a funded company selling into an industry that moves physical things. Congratulations to the team.

source.title: 5U AI lands $3.2M pre-seed for AI freight workforce platform

lead.text: telli has raised €13.1m in seed funding. Founded by Seb Hapte-Selassie, Philipp Baumanns and Finn zur Muehlen, telli builds AI that runs B2C customer operations rather than summarising them afterwards, taking over the calls, the CRM updates and the tickets that each carry their own queue today. Round led by redalpine with Cherry Ventures and Y Combinator following on. That takes a two-year-old Berlin company past €16m raised in total. Congratulations to the team.
